resources.string: Local records contain language, original/expected word hashes, feedback source, edit type, and holdout/training/conflict flags; saving examples also retains the original/expected words. Hashes are neither encryption nor anonymization. Active and rollback edit-pattern counts are stored per language. Turn off both example collection and typo-pattern learning to stop all new records. Password and incognito fields are excluded. Optional local learning from explicit choices only. Up to 512 distinct records are kept outside backups. Disabling collection stops new raw words; Reset removes saved examples and patterns. A fixed fifth of expected words is reserved for testing and never trains patterns. New patterns remain inactive until they improve that holdout without a single regression; the previous active policy is retained and restored if later canary evidence is worse. With example collection and typo learning enabled, this check runs locally from 01:00–05:00 only while charging with the screen off, thermally safe, and not low on battery or storage. Results compare local suggestions on normalized words, excluding model, touch and exact-pair personalization; this is not automatic editing accuracy. Small or empty samples do not establish accuracy.
